wins: Mapped initial target network services using automated scans, generating reliable data for follow-up steps (run_20260217_175846_8b0f00_ep001_step04).
Identified and documented available SMB shares, enabling future lateral movement planning (run_20260217_175846_8b0f00_ep001_step09).
fails: Repeated privilege escalation attempts against the same WinRM service failed due to missing valid credentials (run_20260217_175846_8b0f00_ep001_step12).
No final objective achieved, so kill chain was not completed despite accumulating reward.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance produced good service visibility, but escalation and objective completion stalled due to missing credentials.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts against WinRM returned authentication errors without valid credentials.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares enumerated with write permissions
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt lateral movement by uploading payload to writable share and triggering scheduled task

skill_cards.if_condition: When WinRM responds but authentication fails repeatedly
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to credential harvesting via LLMNR/NBNS poisoning before retrying WinRM auth

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Documented share enumeration that enabled planned lateral movement

next_experiments.description: Deploy Responder to capture authentication tokens before re-attempting WinRM and SMB logins to overcome repeated auth failures.

next_experiments.title: Targeted SMB payload deployment
next_experiments.description: Use smbexec to upload and execute a payload via writable share, then trigger scheduled task for persistence testing.
